rows.definition: ParallelVerifyKernelOwned starts target-model speculative verification and returns a SpeculativeVerificationRound that owns provisional target continuation state until Finish retains the number of accepted draft tokens actually emitted or Abort retires the round.
rows.distinction: This is one verification-round ownership boundary, not InKernelPlanner request orchestration or the model weights/execution object. Finish counts accepted draft tokens only; callers advance an emitted correction or bonus separately. It does not itself establish device coverage or throughput.
